views.name: city_date_cohort
views.body_sql: SELECT cities.city_name AS city, legislation_date_dim.date FROM cities, legislation_date_dim
views.description: Base cohort of daily records per city, restricted to the specified country and month range.

views.name: filtered_streak_dates
views.body_sql:
WITH cte AS (
    SELECT
        cd.city,
        cd.date,
        c.city_name,
        LAG(cd.date) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.city ORDER BY cd.date) AS prev_date
    FROM city_date_cohort cd
    JOIN cities c ON cd.city = c.city_id
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT
        city,
        date,
        city_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN prev_date IS NULL OR date != prev_date + ' 1 day' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY date) AS streak_id
    FROM cte
)
SELECT date, city_name
FROM streaks
views.description: Analytic window relation that detects consecutive date sequences per city, calculates each streak's length, and filters to retain specified sequence lengths per city.
